candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/24 on sw-it-01 allows VLANs [10,30,99], but the approved set for this trunk is {30,99}, so VLAN 10 (OT) is carried on a non-OT-facing uplink.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 10 from the allowed VLAN list of sw-it-01 Gi1/0/24 so that it carries only VLANs 30 and 99.

candidates.claim: sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 trunk allowed VLAN list changed from the approved baseline [30,99] to [10,30,99].
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the approved baseline: revert the trunk allowed list to [30,99], or document it as an approved change.
